title: FRP Grating Supplier in Saudi Arabia: GCC Sourcing Guide 2026
author: ZeAll Team
excerpt: Complete guide for sourcing FRP/GRP grating for Saudi Arabia, UAE and GCC region. Desert UV resistance, chemical plant specs, shipping to Dammam/Jeddah, SASO compliance.
content:
1. FRP Grating Demand in Saudi Arabia & GCC

Saudi Arabia is investing heavily in NEOM, Red Sea Project, Riyadh Metro, SABIC chemical plants and Ma'aden mining. FRP grating is the standard for corrosion-resistant walkways in oil & gas, desalination, wastewater and chemical processing. Local supply is expensive and limited. Importing from China saves 40-55%.

2. Desert UV & Heat Resistance

Saudi summer temperatures reach 50C+. Standard polyester resin may chalk and degrade in 3-5 years. ZeAllgrate offers: UV-stabilized isophthalic polyester (8-10 year outdoor life), vinyl ester (best chemical resistance, 15+ years), and fire-retardant phenolic resin (V-0 rating for oil & gas). All grating includes UV inhibitor and passes ASTM G154 UV aging test.

3. SASO & SABER Compliance

Saudi Arabia requires SABER platform registration for building materials. We provide: product test reports (ASTM E84 fire, ASTM D638 tensile), material safety data sheets (MSDS), and CO with SASO certificate. For Aramco-approved projects, we can supply Aramco-LBP listed manufacturers on request.

4. Shipping to Dammam / Jeddah

Sea freight Shanghai to Dammam: 18-25 days FCL. Jeddah: 22-28 days. Typical CIF Dammam pricing: molded 38mm yellow: USD 52-68/m2. Pultruded 50mm: USD 72-92/m2. We handle export packing, fumigation-free pallets, and customs documentation. MOQ: 30m2 for sample orders.

5. ZeAllgrate GCC Experience

We have supplied FRP grating, handrail systems and covers to: SABIC chemical plants (polyester grating), SWCC desalination (vinyl ester tank covers), Riyadh water treatment plants (molded walkway grating), and oil & gas platforms (GRP handrail & stair).
